remarks:
What a Fabulous Find!

Nestled on approximately 3.5 private wooded acres, this stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort, space, and natural beauty.

The spacious country kitchen features a center island with sink and breakfast bar, double ovens, and an abundance of wood cabinetry and counter space. The inviting family room showcases soaring beamed cathedral ceilings, a beautiful brick gas fireplace, and large windows that fill the home with natural light while offering spectacular views of the surrounding landscape.

The convenient first-floor primary suite provides easy living, while the expansive loft offers flexible space ideal for a home office, guest accommodations, or additional living area. A partially finished walkout basement adds even more living space and features French doors leading to a patio.

Enjoy the outdoors from the oversized wraparound deck with panoramic views of nature and exceptional privacy. Additional outdoor amenities include a gazebo, greenhouse, and storage shed.

The oversized 2.5-car garage is equipped with electricity and heat, making it perfect for vehicles, hobbies, or workshop space.

Recent Updates Include:

New carpet throughout, including the loft
Refinished hardwood floors in the kitchen
Updated plumbing
Updated septic system
New concrete pad
Freshly painted interior walls and new trim throughout
Finished living space created in the walkout lower level with new flooring, ceiling, and closet
New roof on the front half of the home
New siding
All new bathroom fixtures
New light fixtures
Rebuilt front porch
Professionally cleaned ductwork

This unique property offers peace, privacy, and move-in-ready convenience in a truly picturesque setting.
